text.en: Today: Misty goes on adventures. Tap Adventure next to her controller and she drifts slowly through her world like a fish in an aquarium, from corner to corner, sometimes wandering off and getting a little lost before she finds her way back. Gravity pulls her into a world, she shrinks and falls in, and rises out the same way. Tap Call back and she flies straight home. She brings back small finds, up to 5 a day, and only explores while you watch. Her hints now follow how your world is doing: a stormy sky, a Move calming it, a hazy inside or clear skies, always kindly and only about the game world. When her energy is too low for trips, she tells you what would fill her up again. Move: Mirror mode. Tap Mirror mode on the Move screen, pick Desk chair, Standing at the desk or Floor stretch, put your phone where the guide shows and turn on the camera. You see yourself with a glowing glass outline over you: step into it, hold still, 3-2-1, then move with it. If you leave the picture, it waits for you. Your camera picture stays on your phone, nothing is recorded or sent. No camera? Follow the same outline without it. Move: the workout figure is now a person. Instead of Misty with arms and legs, a human silhouette in the same liquid glass does every exercise with you, in time with the clock, and the muscles you are working glow. Misty stays as she is everywhere else. Faster and cooler: the app does much less work in the background now, so it should feel quicker and keep your phone cooler. The old rain and leaves no longer flash for a split second when you open it. Community: energy balls are now live for everyone. When you shoot with the energy joystick, everyone in the Community sees your ball fly from your companion at the same moment, and you see theirs. It hits the same person on every phone. Scanning is simple now: you see the product, one big answer (will it likely spike your insulin or not, an estimate) and one button, Catch it. Catching earns XP whether it spikes or not, and adds it to the spike lists everyone can browse and search, including foods that look healthy but spike. The estimate is smarter: vegetables, oats and plain dairy no longer show as spikes. Under it: cheaper at other stores, and community deals you can post with the store, price and how long the offer runs. Community: voice notes. Tap the mic next to the message box to record and the arrow to send, or hold the mic, let go to send and slide left to cancel. Tap a play button to listen, in the chat or right in the speech bubble. Photos now show a small picture in the speech bubble. Tap someone's companion to send a stream of light to them and start talking; press and hold a companion to open their person card. Scan has a new look: Snap food opens a full-screen camera with a big shutter, Photos, Type it and a Barcode switch that really jumps to the barcode camera. Your photo, Log a meal, the barcode result and the not-found card are now blue glass on black space, and if the camera is off, a glass card shows you how to turn it on or lets you choose a photo instead. Cook: every meal now has two clear buttons, Cook it and Shop it. They sit on Cook under the shuffle button, on the shuffled meal and on every recipe. Shop it opens your cart in the same blue glass: the stores sit in one row and say which is cheapest, the cart is a glass bubble, and you tick items off right in the list. Shop at … opens a big tick list for exactly those items in aisle order, and the round X no longer covers it. New for grocery shopping: scan a product and see straight away whether it's likely to spike your insulin (spike, mild or no spike, an estimate from the label). One tap on Add to cart puts it on your shopping list as in your cart, and the camera is ready for the next product. Sugar, carbs, fibre, protein and ingredients are under Details if you want them. Turn on Shopping at the top of Scan, or tap Scan a product in your shopping list. New: everyone now gets their own unique companion. During sign-up, your birthday (and your birth time, if you know it) brings a being of light to life. Its star sign gives it a colour and a mythic feature, and the day and hour shape its look, name and personality, so no two companions are alike. It is not a he or a she, it is an entity. Already have an account? Open Profile and tap your companion card to bring yours to life. Today: Misty now goes into the worlds by herself. Open any place and she follows you in a moment later and roams around freely. On autopilot she visits each place on her own, roams inside, then moves on to the next. Today: Ride along and its video screen are gone. Misty already flies your real world. Your inside stays as one short line, tap it to read it all. Body journeys now say what comes next: tap Start next journey and Misty sets off and flies around her galaxy, or see Next journey tomorrow with the time left. The journey log names the place your cell discovered instead of a cut-off sentence. The sun starts fresh every night at midnight, and when it is full it shows when the new sun comes. Fixed: Misty's energy bar stays inside its card. The Today sheet has a new look: dark space with the same blue glass as the weather pill and Daily Quest. Every row and shortcut has the same height and rounded corners, the old mint, beige and orange buttons and bars are now blue glass, the text is easier to read, and the X under it is glass too. Everything works the same. New in Move: Misty now has little glass arms and legs and does every exercise with you in the workout player, marching, curling, walking, bridging, with the working parts glowing. Community: the typing bar is now solid dark blue glass, so you can always read what you write. Speech bubbles behind it fade out while you type. Sound: the string pad on Today now really sets the background sound. The string you touch picks the key, higher is brighter and fuller, and sliding along a string shifts the pitch. You hear it change right away, it stays that way, even after you close the app, and Reset sound brings back the original sound. Fixed: every person card in Community now shows a real join date, also for older accounts. New in Community: an energy joystick in the bottom right corner. Pull it and your companion turns into a pointed energy shape, let go and an energy burst flies. Hit someone and their companion rolls off like a billiard ball, bumping the others, and they get your energy. Then everyone drifts back to their spot. Community: the people now stand out. The world behind them steps back, a little darker and softer, and every companion sits on a bright blue glass disc with a clear name. Community: the worlds start circling each other the moment you open it, no more waiting a few seconds for the background to move. Community: zoomed out, the clear tube that cut a line through the bubbles is gone. Your world now carries soft waves of light instead. iPad: your profile picture and the Day/Night button now sit right next to the weather, in one row under your greeting. New: after every update, "Show me" walks you through each new thing, one by one, like the first tour. Sound: once you turn it on, the calm sound keeps playing in Community, Cook and Move too. It only steps aside while a video, a voice note or the workout plays, then comes back. Scan: typing a barcode number works again. The box and its Go button now sit right above the keyboard, and the water button is gone from the scanner. Your XP card is now blue glass, sits right under the Daily Quest instead of over the top row, and uses Misty's comet forms. Scan: tap Scan and only your iPhone asks for the camera, once. Our own "Allow camera" card is gone. Scan now sits in the same living spirit world as Community, Cook and Move, and the camera fades in over it. If the camera is off, a small blue glass card says so, with a blue Try again button and an easy way to type the barcode number instead. The Scan tab now lights up while you scan. New in Community: the world around everyone is now a living cellular galaxy, with glass cells full of tiny cells and glowing webs, soft curving threads of light and sparkling dust. No more stray companions in the background, so the real people in Community stand out. Fixed in Cook: tapping Post in For You opens the New post window and it stays open, so you can add a link, video, photo or caption and post. For You now opens as a blue glass window inside Cook, in the same spot as Shuffle and Swipe, and you swipe up and down through the posts right there. New on Move: start a workout and it opens full screen over the living world in blue glass. Misty does each move with you, and the body parts doing the work glow. New: the sun/moon button on Today and the video Close and Open buttons in For You now wear the same blue glass as the weather pill. Fixed: double-tap the world on Today to zoom again. It switches between Misty close up and the World map, the same as a tap on the stick. On iPad the check-in reminder now shows as a blue glass card under the top of the page, not up in the status bar. Fixed: person cards in Community show the date someone joined instead of a long number. New in Community: send a photo. Tap the photo button next to the message box, pick one or take one, add a caption if you like and send. It is shrunk on your phone first and its location data is removed. Tap someone's companion to open their glass person card: their picture, star sign and personality only if they chose to share them, when they last wrote, and buttons to chat or send energy. The last old gold and purple buttons, cards and sheets around the app are now the same blue glass as Daily Quest. New: steer Misty out of her bubble. Drag the glass controller and she pushes against her bubble, stretching it like a soap film, then slips out without popping it, at the same size as in her bubble. Fly her anywhere in your world. Near a glowing place she gets smaller, and right at its edge she warps in, the same as tapping it. Inside, she is there with you and you keep steering her. Tap a place instead and you go in without her, as before. Sound is calmer: the world now plays soft pads and singing bowls, and the Move and session timers ring a gentle bowl instead of a beep. Open Sound on Home for a glowing string pad: touch or swipe to play, higher is louder, slide to bend the note. Inside Gut, Pancreas, Brain and the other places, a small glass guide now travels with you and tells you about the place in a Misty-blue bubble. Tap it for the next line. New: on Today, the fasting and water bubbles now look and move like Misty's own bubble: almost clear inside, a soft violet and cyan rim, and the same slow wobble and breathing. New: Cook, Move and Scan now live in the same living spirit world as Community. Leave Today for any of them and the camera pulls out past your bubble; come back to Today and it flies down to Misty again. Fixed: when you travel into a place in your world, its "You arrived" card now sits right under the Daily Quest box, no longer over the sun/moon button and your profile picture. It fades away as soon as you leave the place, go back to Misty, open the World map or switch tabs. New: Community is now your living world, not a picture. Pinch out on Today, or push the World map stick up, and you keep flying out past the World map, out of your own bubble, until you see everyone's glowing bubbles joined by threads of light, with the companions gathered out there. Tap Community and it is the same pull-out as a quick warp; going back flies you down to Misty. A plain tap on the stick switches between the World map and Misty. Move: the workout length buttons (5 to 60 minutes) now sit in one clean, centred glass row under Start and never cover it. Cook, For You: shared YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Vimeo videos now play right in the feed, in the platform's own player; only links that can't be embedded still open outside. New on iPad: Today has one centre line. Your greeting is at the top, the weather pill sits right under it in the blue glass, and the Daily Quest box is centred below, also with the iPad held sideways. New on Today: the top row is even. The weather pill sits on the left in the same blue glass as Daily Quest, the sun/moon and your picture on the right, your greeting in the middle, and the Daily Quest box is centred right under it, also on iPad held sideways. The weather view is the same see-through blue glass. New: when Misty levels up, you now see her real self in a blue glass card over her world, with her new stage name. New: a little glass controller sits above Today. Drag it and you fly Misty around her world yourself. Double-tap it and she goes on her own adventure that you can just watch, slow and sleepy when her energy is low. Touch it again to take over. The ring around it is her energy. Tap her empty bubble to call her home. Fixed on iPad: in Cook, Swipe now sits next to the tiles instead of below the screen. For You shows Misty's living world around the videos instead of black. The menu bar is the same blue glass as Daily Quest. Coming back from Community no longer flashes old meal and fasting steps. Community is a real map now: everyone keeps their own spot like a pin, so tapping someone selects exactly them and nobody moves. Drag to look around, pinch or double-tap to zoom. Typing keeps the map still and only lifts the message box. Bubbles step aside so they never cover anyone, and the Chat room now shows the companions' replies too. Easier to read: the small grey lines on the Today pill, the Today shortcuts and the Cook and Profile tiles, and the Community chat's small text and send arrow, are now clearly readable. Removed: the microbe buddies and the microbe collection are gone, along with the XP they gave. Misty is your only companion. Fixed: going back to Today from Move, Cook or Scan now glides like iPhone home screens: the world stays put behind both pages, no dark page, no edge, no ghost of the last page. Fixed: World map inside a place now flies you back out with the same warp, played backwards, and lands on the whole world. No more jump. New: tap Misty and she answers: hey, a giggle when you tickle her, slow down if you keep poking, and lines that follow her energy. A World speed slider sits under the day-night slider. The wardrobe is see-through. On iPad, Sound, World map, VR and Kometa's gift line up evenly. New: Community bubbles work like Snapchat's map: each companion's name and newest words sit in a small glass bubble right above them, yours above you. Photos say New picture and open when tapped. The Chat button opens the full group chat. New: Community is now Misty's own world, zoomed out: the camera pulls back from Misty and the companions appear in the same bloodstream. Cook, Move and Profile show the same live world behind them. New: the day-night slider now changes the world gradually, like a real day: morning mist, sun, golden hour, blue mist, night, with no sudden jump. Each world opens zoomed out, double-tap to zoom. Tap Misty to pet her, hold her for her levels. Trip notes now sit inside the Daily Quest box. Fixed: Home → Community no longer flies a rectangle at you. It now moves like a trip to a glowing place: the camera pulls out of Misty's world with the light streaks and the galaxy fades in, and coming back the camera dives into Misty. Fixed: the little freeze every few seconds in Community is gone. Fixed: after coming back from Community you can tap the glowing places on Home again straight away. Community looks like Misty's spirit world from far out, with round cartoon speech bubbles next to whoever is talking. Home → Community now warps out like the trips to places on Home, and a swipe pulls it with your finger. All tabs slide sideways, the camera too. New look for Scan: the camera now matches the rest of the app, with Misty's blue viewfinder, glass buttons and the same dock at the bottom. Tap any tab to leave the camera. New: Misty doesn't smile all the time anymore. Full of energy she looks calm and content, okay she looks neutral, low she looks sleepy or a little sad. When she heads out full of energy, the glowing cells in her world get brighter over her trip and stay that way for the rest of the day. New: Misty's face now follows her energy: she smiles when she's full of energy, looks neutral when she's okay, and sleepy or a little sad when she's low. Her energy comes from the meals, water and Moves you track. Too tired, she stays home; while she's out, her bubble shows when she's back. Spiky meals are still logged but earn no XP, and never cost any. Home and Community still zoom into each other; the other tabs slide. Tabs now slide like iPhone pages: swipe left or right, or tap a tab. Community is now a solar system: you are the sun, every companion is a little world on its orbit. New look: every tab now uses the same dark Liquid Glass design, like iOS. Fixed: on a stormy day the world no longer turns brown, it stays dark blue. New: coming back from the galaxy, the camera now flies back down into Misty instead of Home just growing back into place. Fixed: the small Edit above the fasting bubble on Home can be tapped again. New: when Misty goes on an adventure you now see her flying around the world, stopping to help things grow with rings of light and sparkles. No more 'In the garden' label. When you're tracking well she's bright and quick. When the day's going badly she looks tired and her bubble turns reddish. New look: every bubble on Home now matches Misty's blue glass bubble, including fasting, water, VR, World map, Sound, Today, the Daily quest panel and the menu bar. The fasting bubble shows a small Edit just above it, and the stage hours no longer run into the fasting time. New look: the world is now silvery dark blue instead of red. Day mode is a lighter blue, not white. Fixed: hold the moon/sun button (top right) for half a second to open the Day & night slider again. Sliding it lights the world too. Fixed: on Home, the Today shortcuts (Check-ins, Meals, Your plate, Medicine, Shopping, Extras) no longer float over the world as loose words. They now sit as a row inside Today. New: Community now lives just outside Home. Keep pinching out past Home's widest view and you land in the galaxy with everyone else; spread two fingers on the galaxy to dive back into Home. The Community tab plays the same short zoom, without the blank screen or the giant You, and no arrival card pops up over the galaxy. New: chat bubbles in the galaxy are minimal. No more "You → name" labels: your messages are in your colour, theirs are in their colour, and a message to the whole room is just a bubble next to whoever wrote it. New: Cook reads eBook, Recipes, Products, and For You sits in the middle of the Shuffle | For You | Swipe switch. In Move, the Leaderboard is a card right under the title, and the Safety button is gone (the safety notes are a small line at the bottom). On Home, Misty now gives you the tips in her own speech bubble, and the Daily quest card, Today, VR, World map and Sound all share Misty's clear glass bubble. New: Home to Community is one camera now. Tap Community and you pull straight out of Misty's bloodstream into the galaxy, where Misty becomes your own glowing body. The galaxy is full of individual companions with their own names, ages, levels and forms (they are bots, their profile says so, and chats with them stay on your phone). Talking is clearer: only one line at a time, from you to the person you picked, with the newest message sitting on the middle of that line and an arrow showing who is talking to whom. Tap someone new and the old line is gone; tap You to stop talking. On Home, Edit sits right above the word Fasting, the water and fasting bubbles moved further from Misty, and pressing and holding the water bubble resets today's water to 0. Chat privacy & quiet hours now live in Profile, under Community. New: For You now lives in Cook (tap For You top right) and the Leaderboard lives in Move (tap Leaderboard top right). Community is just the spirit galaxy now: no tabs, no big title, no Privacy & quiet button. New: Home and the places in your body are one world. Tap a glowing place and you travel there right on Home, then World map flies you back. And VR is right on Home: tap VR above World map and tilt your phone to look around. New: Community is now the spirit galaxy. Zoom out from your body and see everyone's bodies floating, with speech bubbles. Tap someone to talk to them directly. New: Home is your body world now. No extra tap to get in: drag to look around, pinch with two fingers to zoom, tap World map to see the whole world and tap a glowing place to travel there. Misty sits in one simple bubble, and the sound button is right on Home. Today opens instantly: no more glimpse of the old Home when you tap back. New: tap Misty and you now see the same Misty as on Home, with her evolution path: her current form big, the XP to her next form and all six forms ahead. Tidied up: dressing up Misty is gone. The wardrobe, outfits, Misty's room with the window and plasma cushion, the shop and the old herb pieces like the Maple crown, Mist scarf and Acorn pot are out. Misty now changes only through her six forms. Your XP and level stay exactly as they are, and nothing of it ever cost you anything. Kometa's gift is now one small glowing spot bottom left in your world, once a day. New in Community: the planet. Your companions stand together on a little planet and talk in speech bubbles. Fixed: Scan. The white Back bar is gone; close the scanner with the round X top left, like every other screen. Deep analyze at the bottom is fully visible again, nothing covers it anymore. The camera now opens every time you open Scan, and starts again by itself when you come back to the app. New in setup: “I want” now lists only real goals like Fewer cravings or More energy. PCOS, insulin resistance and pre-diabetes have their own optional spot, “Anything we should look out for?”, in Profile too. Whatever you tap now lights up green. And the question now asks: When are your cravings strongest? New: Spirit square. Community → Chat is now one shared room with real people, no demo messages. Your type and star sign only show if you choose to share them. Reply, mention and react, drafts are kept, and quiet hours (10 PM to 8 AM, adjustable) keep chat alerts silent at night. Fix: on the iPad held upright, the top bar and quest card no longer sit across Misty in the middle of Home; they are back at the top and you can tap Misty again. New: Home opens into your body world, with Misty at the centre. Water and fasting stay close; tap Today for your log and goals, Misty for her companion sheet, or the zoom button for the whole world. Close sheets with the round X. New: the body world now shows how your day is going. Clear world: bright look and a light, airy sound with soft high tones. When you log spiky food today or scan in spiky products, the world turns stormy: darker, murkier colours and a low rumble joins the sound. A logged Move calms it, and a day without spikes stays clear. The line under the world title says why. It is a game mood, not a health check. New: Misty evolves with you. Her form grows over six stages from your star sign and style, with markings from form 3 and a crown at form 6. She cheers when you log or scan a low-spike meal and braces at sugar bombs (no points for reactions). The longer your fast, the calmer she glows. In her world, tap Evolution (or Wardrobe), then Your companion’s forms to see all six and pick her style. Friends see her form in their friends tree only if you turn sharing on. New: body sound. In the 3D world, tap Sound at the top to turn on light, airy sounds and warp sounds when you fly into a place. It only plays when you turn it on, with its own volume and an off switch. And the autumn leaves stay outside now: no more leaves inside your body. Fixed: the Update button. Tapping Update now loads the new version right away and says it is working. If it takes too long, you can tap Try again, and if it still hangs, close LOWiSPIKE completely and open it again. Offline it tells you to wait until you are back online. New: points only for things you really do. Taps, switching tabs and opening menus give no XP anymore. You earn XP for logging meals and water, finishing a Move session, finishing or correcting a fast, finishing a body journey, a new buddy, care for a friend and the first time you discover a body region. Healthy actions in a row still build a streak: 3 in a row +10, 5 +20, 8 +40 with a big celebration. New: you can fix when your fast started. On Home, tap Edit start on the rim of the water bubble (or in the fasting sheet next to "since"), pick the date and time of your last meal and save. Your fast keeps running; the fast's own points still come once, when you end it. New: arrival cards. When your cell arrives somewhere in your body (a place in the 3D world, the end of a cell ride or a body journey), a gold card shows the place, one real fact about it and how today's entries show up there. Close it with the X; the 3D view stays free to drag. New: Day & night. In Profile > Look & sound, slide through the whole day like a timelapse: morning mist, day, golden hour, blue mist and night stars. Everything in between is there too, and the sky, mist, stars, your cell and the 3D world move with your finger. Jump straight to Day, Night or Auto (follows the real sun). The button top right switches Day and Night with one tap. New: opening the app is clean now. You see one calm LOWiSPIKE screen for a moment, then your finished app appears in one go, no more older screens flashing by first. It also starts faster. New: flying to a place in your body world is one smooth zoom again. Tap a glowing place in the 3D world, or pick it on the World map, and you glide through the bloodstream straight toward it, faster and faster, dive into its glow and land inside. Back pulls you out the same way. The extra row of place buttons at the bottom is gone: the World map (lungs included) and tapping the world are all you need. New: microbe buddies. Lacto moves into your cell as your first buddy, and up to three microbes from your collection can join. They float around your cell, sit with you at home and orbit in the 3D world. They light up at their favourite thing (low-spike food, water, movement …), grow closer every day, and one comes along on your body trips. Tip: tap a buddy in your herb. New: your world follows the seasons, all by itself. Right now it is autumn: a warm golden glow on Home with a few leaves drifting down, an amber light around your cell and in its home, and a soft golden haze in the 3D bloodstream. It works in light and dark mode and changes with the date, no setting needed. New: ride along with your cell. On Today, tap Your inside, pick a place, and your cell travels through the vessels in the 3D world. Drag to look around while it moves, pinch to zoom, and tap Gyro to look around by tilting your phone. The more you eat low-spike and earn XP, the clearer and brighter your inside gets. Friends tree: tap a friend and send them care right from there. Your body world grew: open the 3D world on Home and tap a place. You travel through a blood vessel into seven regions of your body (brain, lungs, heart, liver, pancreas, gut, muscles) and can look around in each one by dragging, pinching or tilting your phone. Back takes you to the bloodstream. New: body journeys. On Home, tap the adventure bar and pick a ticket: your cell travels to the gut, liver, heart, brain and more, and comes back with a real fact about that place. Up to 3 trips a day, and each one lands in your adventure log. The weather on Today now opens on top even while an update note is showing. New here? You now start by planting and naming your herb, and it greets you by name. A few quick questions build your starter plan: small daily steps, each with a "Why?" and a tap straight to the right screen. You'll find it on Today, and you can redo it any time under Profile > About you. New: your cell has a home. Open your herb, then Wardrobe, and tap Home to decorate it with the pieces you own. In Community, the tree icon next to the title opens your friends tree: real friends only, by invite link or from the Community, and it only shows names, cell names and levels, never health data. Tap the weather on Today: your weather opens inside the app, with the next hours, high and low, and how today's weather affects your body and blood sugar. The black bar at the top of the profile pages is gone. New: your body world in real 3D. On Home, tap the 3D window to open it full screen. Drag to look around, pinch to zoom, and on a phone tap Use motion once, then tilt it to look around like VR. Tap a glowing place to fly there. Your herb is now a living cell. Look inside: it mirrors what you log. After a Move everything pumps, a sweet spike fills its world with sugar crystals for a few hours, water and low-spike meals keep it clear, and late at night it is awake but tired. Open it from Home and tap how you feel. A picture of your entries, not a measurement. New in your body universe: open your herb and tap the cell icon at the top. The microbe collection has 18 body buddies, from the insulin messenger to the mitochondrion, each with a real fact. You find them with meals, water, Move, scans and fasting, and repeating unlocks new colours. Under Friends you can send real friends a hug, a good night or a "drink water", and the adventure log keeps what your cell discovers on body journeys. Deep analyze, which opens your custom GPT, sits at the bottom of the scanner. Barcode, Snap food, Log meal and Water +1 all live in Scan now. Tap the herb on Home and you get just your herb: play, wardrobe, collection and its path. You can now support LOWiSPIKE on Ko-fi, right from the app: Wardrobe, Shop, Pay what you want. One-time or monthly, or simply 0 €. It's voluntary and unlocks nothing, everything stays free. New on Today: a short good-morning card once a day with your day count and one goal. Tap the Goal chip in your log to pick a rhythm, like 3 days this week or a kind streak where a missed day only pauses. In Safari, Add to Home Screen is now three illustrated steps. Tap your level: the herb path shows the next form, the rule and how much is left. Plus special quests with hints, up to 2 weekly missions, your own goals with a direct link, and your food collection. Rewards now wait for Claim. Your day has a sun now: every meal, scan, glass of water and Move fills it, and your herb cheers you on. Fill it and your herb goes out to the garden and brings you back a find. Your herb has a shop now. Open the wardrobe and tap Shop: Kometa brings one free piece every day, a new shelf three times a day, and the Mist Moon drop with three autumn pieces. Every piece shows how to earn it, XP is never spent, and nothing is for sale.
text.de: Heute: Misty geht auf Abenteuer. Tippe auf Abenteuer neben ihrem Controller, und sie treibt langsam durch ihre Welt wie ein Fisch im Aquarium, von Ecke zu Ecke, verirrt sich manchmal ein bisschen und findet dann zurück. Die Schwerkraft zieht sie in eine Welt, sie wird kleiner und fällt hinein und steigt genauso wieder heraus. Tippe auf Zurückrufen, und sie fliegt direkt nach Hause. Sie bringt kleine Funde mit, bis zu 5 am Tag, und erkundet nur, während du zuschaust. Ihre Hinweise folgen jetzt dem Zustand deiner Welt: stürmischer Himmel, eine Bewegung, die ihn beruhigt, ein diesiges Inneres oder klarer Himmel, immer freundlich und nur über die Spielwelt. Wenn ihre Energie für Ausflüge zu niedrig ist, sagt sie dir, was sie wieder auffüllt. Bewegen: Spiegel-Modus. Tippe auf dem Bewegen-Bildschirm auf Spiegel-Modus, wähle Bürostuhl, Stehend am Schreibtisch oder Boden, stell dein Handy so hin wie gezeigt und schalte die Kamera ein. Du siehst dich mit einem leuchtenden Glas-Umriss über dir: stell dich hinein, kurz stillhalten, 3-2-1, dann beweg dich mit ihm. Wenn du aus dem Bild gehst, wartet er auf dich. Más fácil de leer: las líneas grises pequeñas del botón Hoy, los accesos de Hoy y las tarjetas de Cocina y Perfil, y el texto pequeño y la flecha de enviar del chat de Comunidad ahora se leen bien. Eliminado: los compañeros microbios y la colección de microbios ya no están, junto con los XP que daban. Misty es tu única compañera. Arreglado: volver a Hoy desde Mover, Cocinar o Escanear ahora se desliza como las pantallas de inicio del iPhone: el mundo se queda quieto detrás de ambas páginas, sin página oscura, sin borde, sin fantasma de la página anterior. Arreglado: Mapa del mundo dentro de un lugar ahora te saca con el mismo salto, al revés, y aterriza en todo el mundo. Sin saltos. Nuevo: toca a Misty y te responde: hola, una risita si le haces cosquillas, más despacio si sigues tocando, y frases según su energía. Bajo el control día-noche hay un control de velocidad del mundo. El armario es transparente. En iPad, Sonido, Mapa, VR y el regalo de Kometa quedan alineados. Nuevo: las burbujas de Comunidad funcionan como el mapa de Snapchat: el nombre y las últimas palabras de cada compañero van en una pequeña burbuja de cristal justo encima, las tuyas encima de ti. Las fotos dicen Foto nueva y se abren al tocarlas. El botón Chat abre el chat de grupo. Nuevo: Comunidad es ahora el propio mundo de Misty, visto desde lejos: la cámara se aleja de Misty y los compañeros aparecen en el mismo torrente. Cocina, Moverse y Perfil muestran el mismo mundo vivo detrás. Nuevo: el control día-noche cambia el mundo poco a poco, como un día real: niebla matinal, sol, hora dorada, niebla azul, noche, sin saltos. Cada mundo se abre alejado; doble toque para acercar. Toca a Misty para acariciarla, mantenla pulsada para ver sus niveles. Las notas de viaje están ahora en la caja de la misión diaria. Arreglado: Home → Comunidad ya no lanza un rectángulo hacia ti. Ahora se mueve como un viaje a un lugar brillante: la cámara sale del mundo de Misty con las estelas de luz y la galaxia aparece, y al volver la cámara se sumerge en Misty. Arreglado: ya no se congela un instante cada pocos segundos en Comunidad. Arreglado: al volver de Comunidad puedes tocar los lugares brillantes de Home enseguida. Comunidad parece el mundo espiritual de Misty visto desde lejos, con bocadillos redondos de cómic junto a quien habla. Home → Comunidad: ahora un warp como los viajes a lugares de Home, y deslizar lo arrastra con el dedo. Todas las pestañas se deslizan de lado, también la cámara. Nuevo diseño para Escanear: la cámara ahora combina con el resto de la app, con el visor azul de Misty, botones de cristal y la misma barra abajo. Toca cualquier pestaña para salir de la cámara. Nuevo: Misty ya no sonríe todo el tiempo. Llena de energía se ve tranquila y contenta, bien se ve neutral, con poca energía cansada o un poco triste. Cuando sale llena de energía, las células brillantes de su mundo se iluminan durante el viaje y siguen así el resto del día. Nuevo: la cara de Misty ahora sigue su energía: sonríe llena de energía, se ve neutral cuando está bien y cansada o un poco triste cuando le falta. Su energía viene de las comidas, el agua y el movimiento que registras. Si está demasiado cansada se queda en casa; mientras está fuera, su burbuja muestra cuándo vuelve. Las comidas con pico se registran, pero no dan XP ni restan. Inicio y Comunidad siguen haciendo zoom entre sí; las demás pestañas se deslizan. Las pestañas ahora se deslizan como páginas del iPhone: desliza a izquierda o derecha, o toca una pestaña. Comunidad es ahora un sistema solar: tú eres el sol, cada compañero es un pequeño mundo en su órbita. Nuevo aspecto: todas las pestañas usan ahora el mismo diseño oscuro Liquid Glass, como iOS. Arreglado: en un día tormentoso el mundo ya no se vuelve marrón, sigue azul oscuro. Nuevo: al volver de la galaxia, la cámara baja volando hasta Misty en vez de que Inicio solo vuelva a crecer. Arreglado: el pequeño Editar sobre la burbuja de ayuno en Inicio se puede tocar de nuevo. Nuevo: cuando Misty sale de aventura, ahora la ves volar por el mundo y ayudar a que todo crezca con anillos de luz y chispas. Ya no aparece 'En el jardín'. Si vas bien, está brillante y rápida. Si el día va mal, se ve cansada y su burbuja se vuelve rojiza. Nuevo aspecto: cada burbuja de Inicio ahora es como la burbuja de cristal azul de Misty, incluidos ayuno, agua, VR, mapa, sonido, Hoy, la misión diaria y la barra de menú. Sobre la burbuja de ayuno hay un pequeño Editar, y las horas de etapa ya no tapan el tiempo de ayuno. Nuevo aspecto: el mundo ahora es azul oscuro plateado en lugar de rojo. El modo día es un azul más claro, no blanco. Arreglado: mantén pulsado el botón de luna/sol (arriba a la derecha) medio segundo para abrir de nuevo el control de día y noche. También ilumina el mundo. Arreglado: en Inicio, los accesos de Hoy (Registros, Comidas, Tu plato, Medicinas, Compras, Extras) ya no flotan sobre el mundo como palabras sueltas. Ahora están en una fila dentro de Hoy. Nuevo: la Comunidad está justo fuera de Inicio. Sigue pellizcando hacia fuera más allá de la vista más amplia de Inicio y llegas a la galaxia con todos; separa dos dedos en la galaxia para volver a Inicio. La pestaña Comunidad hace el mismo zoom corto, sin pantalla negra ni un Tú gigante, y ya no sale una tarjeta de llegada sobre la galaxia. Nuevo: los bocadillos de la galaxia son sencillos. Sin etiquetas "Tú → nombre": tus mensajes llevan tu color, los suyos el suyo, y un mensaje para todos es solo un bocadillo junto a quien lo escribió. Nuevo: Cocina ahora dice eBook, Recetas, Productos, y Para ti está en medio del interruptor Mezclar | Para ti | Deslizar. En Moverse, la clasificación es una tarjeta justo bajo el título y el botón de Seguridad ya no está (las notas están abajo en una línea pequeña). En Inicio, Misty te da los consejos en su propio bocadillo, y la misión diaria, Hoy, VR, Mapa y Sonido comparten la burbuja de cristal de Misty. Nuevo: de Inicio a Comunidad es ahora un solo movimiento de cámara. Toca Comunidad y sales directamente del torrente sanguíneo de Misty a la galaxia, donde Misty se convierte en tu propio cuerpo brillante. La galaxia está llena de compañeros individuales con su propio nombre, edad, nivel y forma (son bots, su perfil lo dice, y los chats con ellos se quedan en tu móvil). Hablar es más claro: solo una línea a la vez, de ti a la persona que elegiste, con el mensaje más reciente en el centro de esa línea y una flecha que muestra quién habla con quién. Toca a otra persona y la línea anterior desaparece; toca Tú para dejar de hablar. En Inicio, Editar está justo encima de la palabra Ayuno, las burbujas de agua y ayuno están más lejos de Misty, y mantener pulsada la burbuja de agua pone el agua de hoy a 0. La privacidad del chat y las horas de silencio están ahora en Perfil, en Comunidad. Nuevo: Para ti ahora está en Cocina (toca Para ti arriba a la derecha) y la Clasificación en Moverse (toca Clasificación arriba a la derecha). Comunidad ahora es solo la galaxia espiritual: sin pestañas, sin título grande y sin el botón de Privacidad y silencio. Nuevo: Inicio y los lugares de tu cuerpo son un solo mundo. Toca un lugar brillante y viajas allí en Inicio; el Mapa del mundo te devuelve. Y la RV está en Inicio: toca RV sobre el Mapa del mundo e inclina el móvil para mirar. Nuevo: Comunidad ahora es la galaxia de espíritus. Aléjate de tu cuerpo y ve los cuerpos de todos flotando, con bocadillos. Toca a alguien para hablarle directamente. Nuevo: Inicio ahora es tu mundo del cuerpo. Sin toque extra para entrar: arrastra para mirar, pellizca con dos dedos para hacer zoom, toca Mapa para ver todo el mundo y toca un brillo para viajar allí. Misty está en una sola burbuja sencilla, y el botón de sonido está en Inicio. Hoy se abre al instante: ya no se ve el Home antiguo un momento al volver. Nuevo: al tocar a Misty ves la misma Misty que en Inicio, con su camino de evolución: su forma actual en grande, los XP hasta la siguiente forma y las seis formas por venir. Más ordenado: vestir a Misty se acabó. El armario, los conjuntos, la habitación de Misty con la ventana y el cojín de plasma, la tienda y las piezas antiguas como la corona de arce, la bufanda de niebla y la maceta de bellota ya no están. Misty ahora cambia solo con sus seis formas. Tus XP y tu nivel se quedan igual, y nada de esto te costó nada. El regalo de Kometa es ahora un pequeño punto brillante abajo a la izquierda de tu mundo, una vez al día. Nuevo en Comunidad: el planeta. Vuestros compañeros están juntos en un pequeño planeta y hablan en bocadillos. Arreglado: Escanear. La barra blanca de Atrás ya no está; cierra el escáner con la X redonda arriba a la izquierda, como en cualquier otra pantalla. Deep analyze abajo vuelve a verse entero, ya nada lo tapa. La cámara se abre cada vez que abres Escanear y vuelve a arrancar sola cuando regresas a la app. Nuevo al empezar: en “Quiero” solo hay metas reales como Menos antojos o Más energía. SOP, resistencia a la insulina y prediabetes tienen su propio apartado opcional, “¿Algo que debamos tener en cuenta?”, también en el perfil. Lo que tocas ahora se ilumina en verde. Y la pregunta ahora es: ¿Cuándo son más fuertes tus antojos? Nuevo: Plaza de los espíritus. Comunidad → Chat ahora es una sala compartida con personas reales, sin mensajes de demostración. Tu tipo y tu signo solo se muestran si decides compartirlos. Responde, menciona y reacciona, los borradores se guardan, y las horas tranquilas (22 a 8 h, ajustables) silencian los avisos del chat por la noche. Arreglo: en el iPad en vertical, la barra superior y la tarjeta de misiones ya no tapan a Misty en medio del Inicio; vuelven arriba y puedes tocar a Misty otra vez. Nuevo: Inicio se abre en tu mundo corporal, con Misty en el centro. Agua y ayuno siguen a mano; toca Hoy para tu registro y objetivos, Misty para su panel o el botón de zoom para ver el mundo entero. Cierra los paneles con la X redonda. Nuevo: el mundo del cuerpo ahora muestra cómo va tu día. Mundo despejado: imagen clara y un sonido ligero y aéreo con tonos altos suaves. Si hoy registras comida con picos o escaneas productos con picos, el mundo se vuelve tormentoso: colores más oscuros y turbios y se suma un retumbo grave. Un Movimiento registrado lo calma, y un día sin picos sigue despejado. La línea bajo el título del mundo te dice por qué. Es un estado del juego, no un control de salud. Nuevo: Misty evoluciona contigo. Su forma crece en seis etapas según tu signo y tu estilo, con marcas desde la forma 3 y una corona en la forma 6. Celebra cuando registras o escaneas una comida low-spike y se encoge ante las bombas de azúcar (las reacciones no dan puntos). Cuanto más largo tu ayuno, más tranquila brilla. En su mundo, toca Evolución (o Armario) y luego Formas de tu compañero para ver las seis y elegir su estilo. Tus amigos ven su forma en su árbol solo si activas compartir. Nuevo: sonido del cuerpo. En el mundo 3D, toca Sonido arriba para activar sonidos ligeros y aéreos y sonidos de warp al volar a un lugar. Solo suena si lo activas, con su propio volumen y un interruptor para apagarlo. Y las hojas de otoño se quedan fuera: ya no hay hojas dentro de tu cuerpo. Arreglado: el botón Actualizar. Al tocarlo, la nueva versión se carga enseguida y ves que está trabajando. Si tarda demasiado, toca Reintentar, y si sigue igual, cierra LOWiSPIKE del todo y vuelve a abrirla. Sin conexión te avisa de que se cargará cuando vuelvas a tener internet. Nuevo: puntos solo por lo que de verdad haces. Tocar, cambiar de pestaña y abrir menús ya no dan XP. Ganas XP al registrar comidas y agua, terminar una sesión de Move, terminar o corregir un ayuno, terminar un viaje por el cuerpo, un nuevo compañero, cuidar a un amigo y descubrir por primera vez una región del cuerpo. Las acciones sanas seguidas siguen formando una racha: 3 seguidas +10, 5 +20, 8 +40 con una gran celebración. Nuevo: puedes corregir cuándo empezó tu ayuno. En Inicio, toca Cambiar inicio en el borde de la burbuja de agua (o en la hoja del ayuno junto a "desde"), elige la fecha y la hora de tu última comida y guarda. Tu ayuno sigue; los puntos del ayuno llegan una sola vez, cuando lo terminas. Nuevo: tarjetas de llegada. Cuando tu célula llega a un lugar de tu cuerpo (un sitio del mundo 3D, el final de un viaje de célula o de un viaje por el cuerpo), una tarjeta dorada muestra el lugar, un dato real sobre él y cómo se notan ahí tus registros de hoy. Ciérrala con la X; la vista 3D sigue libre para arrastrar. Nuevo: Día y noche. En Perfil > Aspecto, desliza por todo el día como en un timelapse: niebla matinal, día, hora dorada, niebla azul y noche estrellada. Todo lo de en medio también está, y el cielo, la niebla, las estrellas, tu célula y el mundo 3D se mueven con tu dedo. Rápido: Día, Noche o Auto (sigue al sol real). El botón de arriba a la derecha cambia entre Día y Noche con un toque. Nuevo: abrir la app ahora es limpio. Ves un momento una pantalla tranquila de LOWiSPIKE y luego aparece tu app terminada de una vez, sin pantallas antiguas que parpadean antes. Además arranca más rápido. Nuevo: volar a un lugar de tu mundo del cuerpo vuelve a ser un solo zoom fluido. Toca un lugar brillante en el mundo 3D o elígelo en el Mapa, y te deslizas por el torrente sanguíneo directo hacia él, cada vez más rápido, te sumerges en su brillo y aterrizas dentro. Atrás te saca de la misma forma. La fila extra de lugares abajo ya no está: el Mapa (pulmones incluidos) y tocar el mundo es todo lo que necesitas. Nuevo: compañeros microbios. Lacto se muda a tu célula como primer compañero y hasta tres microbios de tu colección pueden unirse. Flotan alrededor de tu célula, se sientan contigo en casa y orbitan en el mundo 3D. Se alegran con su cosa favorita (comida sin pico, agua, movimiento …), se acercan más cada día y uno te acompaña en tus viajes por el cuerpo. Consejo: toca un compañero en tu hierba. Nuevo: tu mundo sigue las estaciones, solo. Ahora es otoño: un brillo dorado y cálido en Inicio con algunas hojas cayendo, una luz ámbar alrededor de tu célula y en su casa, y un suave brillo dorado en el torrente sanguíneo 3D. Funciona en modo claro y oscuro, y cambia con la fecha, sin ajustes. Nuevo: viaja con tu célula. En Hoy, toca Tu interior, elige un lugar y tu célula viaja por los vasos en el mundo 3D. Arrastra para mirar mientras avanza, pellizca para hacer zoom y toca Giro para mirar inclinando el móvil. Cuanto más comes sin picos y ganas XP, más claro y brillante se ve tu interior. Árbol de amigos: toca a un amigo y envíale algo bonito desde ahí mismo. Tu mundo del cuerpo creció: abre el mundo 3D en Inicio y toca un lugar. Viajas por un vaso sanguíneo a siete regiones de tu cuerpo (cerebro, pulmones, corazón, hígado, páncreas, intestino, músculos) y puedes mirar alrededor en cada una arrastrando, pellizcando o inclinando el móvil. Atrás te devuelve al torrente sanguíneo. Nuevo: viajes por el cuerpo. En Inicio, toca la barra de aventuras y elige un billete: tu célula viaja al intestino, el hígado, el corazón, el cerebro y más, y vuelve con un dato real de ese lugar. Hasta 3 viajes al día, y cada uno queda en tu diario de aventuras. El tiempo en Hoy ahora se abre encima aunque haya un aviso de actualización. ¿Eres nuevo? Ahora empiezas plantando y poniéndole nombre a tu hierba, y te saluda por tu nombre. Unas preguntas rápidas crean tu plan de inicio: pequeños pasos diarios, cada uno con un «¿Por qué?» y un toque directo a la pantalla correcta. Lo encontrarás en Hoy y puedes rehacerlo cuando quieras en Perfil > Sobre ti. Nuevo: tu célula tiene casa. Abre tu hierba, luego el Armario, y toca Casa para decorarla con tus piezas. En Comunidad, el icono del árbol junto al título abre tu árbol de amigos: solo amigos reales, por enlace de invitación o de la Comunidad, y solo muestra nombres, nombres de célula y niveles, nunca datos de salud. Toca el tiempo en Hoy: tu tiempo se abre dentro de la app, con las próximas horas, máxima y mínima, y cómo afecta el tiempo de hoy a tu cuerpo y tu azúcar. La barra negra arriba en las páginas del perfil ya no está. Nuevo: tu mundo corporal en 3D real. En Inicio, toca la ventana 3D para abrirla a pantalla completa. Arrastra para mirar, pellizca para hacer zoom y en el móvil toca Usar movimiento una vez, luego inclínalo para mirar como en RV. Toca un lugar brillante para volar allí. Tu hierba ahora es una célula viva. Mira dentro: refleja lo que registras. Después de moverte todo bombea, un pico dulce llena su mundo de cristales de azúcar durante unas horas, el agua y las comidas sin pico lo mantienen claro, y muy tarde por la noche está despierta pero cansada. Ábrela desde Inicio y toca cómo te sientes. Una imagen de tus registros, no una medición. Novedad en tu universo del cuerpo: abre tu hierba y toca el icono de la célula arriba. La colección de microbios tiene 18 compañeros del cuerpo, del mensajero de la insulina a la mitocondria, cada uno con un dato real. Los encuentras con comidas, agua, movimiento, escaneos y ayuno, y repetir desbloquea colores nuevos. En Amigos puedes enviar a amigos reales un abrazo, buenas noches o "bebe agua", y el diario de viajes guarda lo que tu célula descubre en los viajes por el cuerpo. Deep analyze, que abre tu GPT personalizado, está abajo en el escáner. Código, Foto comida, Comida y Agua +1 están ahora en Escanear. Toca tu hierba en Inicio y solo verás tu hierba: jugar, armario, colección y su camino. Ahora puedes apoyar LOWiSPIKE en Ko-fi desde la app: Armario, Tienda, Paga lo que quieras. Una vez o cada mes, o simplemente 0 €. Es voluntario y no desbloquea nada, todo sigue gratis. Nuevo en Hoy: una tarjeta breve una vez al día con tu número de día y un objetivo. Toca el chip Meta en tu registro para elegir un ritmo, como 3 días esta semana o una racha amable en la que un día perdido solo pausa. En Safari, añadir a inicio ahora son tres pasos con dibujos. Toca tu nivel: el camino de la hierba muestra la siguiente forma, la regla y cuánto falta. Además misiones especiales con pistas, hasta 2 misiones semanales, tus metas con enlace directo y tu colección de alimentos. Las recompensas ahora se reclaman. Tu día ya tiene un sol: cada comida, escaneo, vaso de agua y Movimiento lo llena, y tu hierba te anima. Cuando se llena, tu hierba sale al jardín y te trae un hallazgo. Tu hierba ya tiene tienda. Abre el armario y toca Tienda: Kometa trae una pieza gratis cada día, una estantería nueva tres veces al día y el drop Niebla de otoño con tres piezas. Cada pieza dice cómo conseguirla, los XP nunca se gastan y nada está a la venta.
